from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689869/attempts/bb90a5c04b7e45689f74d9e2a14a4f73/system/state/workspace/programs/task-f23257be.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    """Shift all non-background cells down by one row, clipping at the bottom."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # ARC grids here use a uniform background; preserve its color in the new top row.
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda c: sum(row.count(c) for row in grid))
    out = [[bg for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]
    for r in range(h - 1):
        for c in range(w):
            out[r + 1][c] = grid[r][c]
    return out
'''
